side:4.text: After Adrasteia leaves Kratos and Deimos in the Laconian Woods, the two ends up hearing a sound from a aulos. Deimos recalls seeing reeds in Vasilis' hideout and wonders if he carved an aulos. Kratos feels that music is a waste of time, which makes Deimos unable to believe he is even saying that. The two then split up to search for new clues with their new bust abilities.
